remarks: Location, Location, Location! Charming 2nd Floor Apartment within walking distance of Harbor Point and Stamford Railroad (for fast access into Manhattan!) This beautiful 2nd floor apartment, accessible via stairs, boasts high ceilings and intricate architectural details that create a distinctive and welcoming atmosphere.  Enjoy cooking in the recently upgraded kitchen, which features a new gas range and hood, a new refrigerator, and an appealing stainless steel dishwasher.  The large, light-filled living room includes a decorative fireplace, while the roomy bedroom offers two closets and access to a small private deck perfect watching street life.  The full bathroom includes a tub, single vanity, and a toilet, providing comfort and functionality.  Benefit from lower-level coin-operated shared laundry facilities and one dedicated parking spot at the rear of the property.   Experience affordable living in a well-appointed space! Maximum 2 occupants. No pets (sorry). Utilities $200 a month (heat, hot water, cooking gas & electricity). Tenant(s) to secure their own internet/cable. Good credit and stable employment essential~
